POSESHOT / RELEASE NOTES

More precise,
more freedom to direct.

Explore how PoseShot's scene composition, pose editing, and camera tools
evolved through dated development updates.

Project period 2026.05 — 2026.08

2026.08.122026.08.052026.07.30
2026.08.12Change log

Camera path recording and pose interpolation

Added

  • Camera Path Record

    Record simple camera movements and pose changes after saving frames with Frame Save.

  • Pose Interpolation

    Added interpolation between poses.

Improved

  • Context menu

    Moved complex interfaces and frequently used functions into the context menu for easier access.

2026.08.05Change log

Hand pose editing and more stable controls

Added

  • Hand Editor

    Added the Hand Editor for editing hand poses.

  • Apply poses by body part

    Apply a pose to a selected region, such as the upper or lower body.

  • Copy and paste poses

    Copy an existing pose and paste it for reuse.

  • Infinity Grid

    Added Infinity Grid to the scene editor.

Fixed

  • Image2Pose timeout

    Fixed the 504 error that occurred when processing exceeded 30 seconds. Changed fal API calls from synchronous to asynchronous processing.

  • Rotation Gizmo sensitivity

    Reduced excessive sensitivity in rotation controls.

2026.07.30Change log

Expanded scene composition and detailed editing

Added

  • Eight basic primitives

    Added Sphere, Cuboid, Wall, Cylinder, Capsule3D, Cone, Torus, and Plane.

  • Multiple selection, copy, and paste

    Supports multiple selection with Cmd, Ctrl, and Shift, plus Cmd/Ctrl+C and Cmd/Ctrl+V shortcuts.

  • Finger editing

    Added editing of character fingers.

  • Transform editing

    Added move, rotate, and scale gizmos, along with numerical input controls.

  • Colors for identifying meshes

    Assign colors to primitive and character meshes to distinguish objects.

  • Manual Detection Mask for Image2Pose

    If automatic detection fails, manually define a character's Detection Mask. Manual detection supports one character at a time.

  • Call Image2Pose using an image URL

    Run Image2Pose externally by passing an image URL. A separate guide linked from the original document explains how to retrieve editing results.
